entities.name: Oana Vitellius I
entities.description: Famous human Azorius arbiter who secretly made a deal with Dimir agent Tarem.

entities.name: Tarem
entities.description: Dimir notion thief who steals thoughts and memories and has not aged.

entities.name: Johvann III
entities.description: Arbiter who adjudicated Oana's lost case.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The guild of law Oana serves.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: The guild of secrets whose agent Tarem made the deal.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: Guild whose holding was broken into.

events.summary: Young defender Oana loses a case before Johvann III on a technicality.
events.quote: Oana lost a case adjudicated by arbiter Johvann III due to a technicality

events.summary: Tarem offers Oana the memories of her grandfather in exchange for a later Dimir service.
events.quote: He offered Oana the opportunity to gain the memories of her deceased grandfather Otho Vitellius II

events.summary: Oana agrees, but Tarem alters her memories so she remembers refusing.
events.quote: Tarem altered her memories so that she would remember denying him

events.summary: Thirty years later Tarem returns unaged and reveals the truth.
events.quote: Tarem revealed to Oana the truth

events.summary: Tarem asks Oana to falsify a judgment; she refuses, breaking the deal, and flees.
events.quote: Oana refused Taram, however, breaking their deal, and fled.

events.summary: Oana writes a confession and resignation and contacts a trainee for legal help.
events.quote: she wrote and signed a letter of confession, her resignation, and abstainment from any future trials

relations.quote: famous human arbiter of the Azorius guild
her deceased grandfather Otho Vitellius II
